This transformation satisfies INLINEFORM1 , and BIBREF16 show that its Jacobian matrix is triangular with all ones on the main diagonal. Thus the Jacobian determinant is always equal to one (i.e. volume-preserving) and the invertibility condition is naturally satisfied.
